name: Variety Show
description: Come watch your friends sing, dance, act and more! Event is on Friday, March 20th at 4pm.

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! Every spring, the PTA hosts a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, they're partnering with the local children's bookstore Hicklebee's. The book fair will be held from Tuesday, March 24 to Thursday, March 26 from 8:30am to 3:00pm in the Library. There will also be a special Family Night on Tuesday, March 24 from 5:00pm to 7:00pm.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: The Multicultural Fair is a beloved tradition at the school. Parents are invited to share their culture by helping with a country booth, fashion show, or group cultural performance. Solo and duo performances are encouraged to be done at the Variety Show on March 20th. The fair will be held from 4pm to 7pm on Friday, April 24th.

name: Yearbook Purchase Deadline
description: If you haven't purchased the yearbook, please purchase it before April 20th. No yearbooks will be sold once they are distributed.

name: ELA - CAT/PT Testing
description: 3rd - 5th grade students will take the ELA - CAT/PT testing from April 20th - 24th.

name: Math CAT/PT Testing
description: 3rd - 5th grade students will take the Math CAT/PT testing from April 27th - May 1st.

name: Art Vista Show
description: The annual Art Vista Show will be held on Tuesday, May 5th.

name: Gold Rush
description: The 4th grade Gold Rush event will be held on Friday, May 8th.

name: Colonial Day
description: The 5th grade Colonial Day event will be held on Friday, May 15th.

name: K/3 Buddy Egg Hunt
description: Kindergarten and 3rd grade classes will be having a Spring Egg Hunt together. Parents need to bring 16 plastic eggs filled with non-candy items like stickers, erasers, or small toys by April 1st.

name: Memorial Day
description: No school on Memorial Day, May 25th.

name: Last Day of School
description: The last day of school is May 29th, which is a minimum day with dismissal at 12:06pm. Students can wear Aloha shirts.

name: K-2 Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farm
description: The K-2 classes will be going on a field trip to Hidden Villa Farm. Parents should pack a disposable lunch and water bottle for their child, and wear closed-toe shoes. Chaperones should arrive at 8:45am.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: Students should bring 1 Valentine's Day card for each of the 22 students in the class, leaving the 'To:' section blank. Students can also wear pajamas to school.

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our PTA meeting in the cafeteria following Community Monday.

name: Family Fun Night - The Kebab Shop
description: Show the flyer when ordering in store or use code FUNDRAISER for online orders and 25% of sales will go the PTA!
location: The Kebab Shop - 5110 Cherry Ave Ste 30

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. Volunteers are needed once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday).

name: Castillero Athletic Booster Club
description: Attention 5th grade parents! Looking to get involved at Castillero? Consider joining the Castillero Athletic Booster Club (CABC) Board!

name: See's Candies Fundraiser
description: Support Our CMBC Program – Sweeten Easter & Mother's Day! Every purchase directly supports our young musicians and helps keep our music program strong.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos
description: 5th grade parents - baby photos are due. Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Page Finalization
description: The draft of the yearbook will be finalized right after the Spring Break. If you are a parent yearbook POC, please finalize your pages by the end of this week!

name: PTA Board Positions for 2026-27
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! Serving on the PTA Executive Board offers a behind-the-scenes look at how our fundraising efforts work and provides a direct way to support and strengthen our school community.
